analysis.grid: 22 x 22, average-resampled in a local Transverse Mercator projection per cell
analysis.method: terrain_features() from prep/mars_prep.py (same code as Mars); steep threshold 15 deg; roughness sigma 1000 m

eligibility.note: Excluded land-cover threshold is provisional. Cells are region centres, not verified access points.

sources.dataset: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (ESA / Airbus), AWS Open Data copernicus-dem-30m
MODIS MOD44B v061 Vegetation Continuous Fields (Percent_NonVegetated), mean 2022-2024
MODIS MCD12Q1 v061 Land Cover (LC_Type1, IGBP), mosaic of 2020-2025, newest on top
sources.used_for: eligibility: excluded land cover, barren fraction
